entries.title: 3F Arrillaga Student Center
entries.text: The Commons and Takaki Terrace will be closed all day tomorrow, Wed, 11/18 for a multiple school conference. Pds 1-5 study halls will be in Seto. Thank you. SRS: Show your appreciation. Grab thank you cards from CCO or SAO office. Please write and hand-deliver a personal note to your teachers writing your recommendation letters, to thank them for their time and support. GRS 11-12: FOOD4THOUGHT: ALOHA HARVEST! Way too often, edible, nutritious food cannot reach those who need it. Aloha Harvest plays a critical role in this food rescue and distribution! Watch this video (1:43) about what they do for our food cycle. How might you get involved with Aloha Harvest? Meet their CEO before school at the chapel on Wed and Fri this week. Contact Ms. Sakuda in C+CE Ofc with questions. GRS 9-10: CHAPEL:--LETTER-WRITING PROJECT FOR FOODBANK: Rally your friends and clubs for our project for the Hawaiʻi Foodbank! Students, stop by the tables right here, in the back of the chapel to pick up templates for your group, or just sit and write a quick, happy note yourself. These will be included with the food that keiki take home from school, to their families in need.

entries.title: Letter-writing Project for Foodbank
entries.text: Annual letter-writing project for the Hawaiʻi Foodbank, is in full-swing, aiming for 2500 letters! Stop by tables in back of chapel OR in the library to write a quick, happy note; these will be included with the food that keiki take home from school, to their families in need. You can also email Ms. Sakuda in the C+CE Office for a stack of templates for your club or team.
